name: cubic-quintic
theorem: Cubic-quintic upper bound: K_G <= pi/(2 gamma) <= 1.7818666069360661 at gamma = 0.881545409 > rho_* = log(1+sqrt2); improvement over Krivine >= 3.4737e-4.

scheme.partitions: f(w,x) = sgn(w + theta He3(x)),  g(w,x) = sgn(w - theta He3(x)),  He3(x) = x^3 - 3x

parameters.note: exact decimals (the certificate is rigorous for these exact rationals); all derived quantities are outward-rounded Arb enclosures

correlation_function: H(t) = (pi/2) E[f g] = (pi/2) sum_{a,b} A_{a,b}^2 rho(t)^a (-t)^b,  A_{a,b} = E_X[H_b(X) q_a(theta He3(X))]

criterion.statement: gamma + Delta_H < b_1  with  Delta_H = sum_{m>=3 odd} |b_m|  (single inequality)
criterion.why_sufficient: Prop. inverse-certificate-from-near-linearity: M(gamma) <= (gamma+Delta_H)/b_1 < 1, then finite-dimensional transfer + Krivine preprocessing

computation.head: grid_M251.json (certified A-grid atom; rebuild_grid.py regenerates) + gkcore.bseries2d
computation.d3h: certify_d3h.py: combined-kernel trace average, B3^2 <= (pi^2/6)(1/pi) int_0^pi S, composite 4-pt GL point values + cancellation-free S^(8) panel remainder
